sentences.text:
Author: Shivakant Prasad
Bench: Shivakant Prasad
.11.2018 p.b.
Crr 2701 of 2018 In Re: Sandeep Sehgal & Ors.
Mr. Sandipan Ganguly, Mr. S. Chowdhury, Mr. S. Mohanti.

In this revisional application, the petitioner has assailed the judgment and order dated 21st August,
2018 passed by the learned Additional Sessions Judge, Fast Track Court No.2 in Criminal Appeal No.54 of 2014 thereby affirming the judgment and order dated 25th March, 2014 passed by the learned Senior Municipal Magistrate, 1st Court Kolkata in Case No.11D of 2007 thereby convicting the petitioners under Section 16(1A) of the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1974 and sentencing them to S.I. for six months with payment of fine of Rs.5,000/- each in default directing them to suffer a further S.I. for one month each inter alia on the ground stated in the petition.
It is submitted by the learned counsel for the petitioners that the petitioner no.1 and 2 herein are undoubtedly partners of M/s. Kasan Restaurant.
Having perused the judgments of the learned court below and upon hearing learned counsel for the petitioners, the application is required to be heard on its merit.

Accordingly, let there be a Rule issued through the Chief Metropolitan Magistrate calling upon the opposite parties to show cause as to why the judgment and order dated 21st August, 2018 passed by the learned Additional Sessions Judge, Fast Track Court No.2, shall not be stayed or quashed within four weeks.

entities.text: Additional Sessions Judge, Fast Track Court
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Issue usual notices upon the opposite parties.
Let there be stay of the operation of the judgments for a period of eight weeks from the date hereof.
Let the matter be listed under the heading "Contested Application" after expiry of seven weeks.

(Shivakant Prasad, J.)
CRR/2701/2018 on 14 November, 2018 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/172434742/
